jobs.title: Head of Finance & Fundraising
jobs.description:
Searcheatt is looking for a Co-founding CMO — help us reach millions of food lovers!
Searcheatt (searcheatt.com) is the platform for everyone who loves cooking, from beginners to professional chefs. We're at a very early stage and looking for the person who will turn our brand into a household name.
What Searcheatt does
Healthy recipes tailored to each person's budget.
Creators earn money from their recipe views.
Ingredient price comparison to save on groceries.
Cooking games and challenges for the community.
Artificial Intelligence that personalizes recipes, shopping lists, and nutrition recommendations. In addition, an AI cooking companion that guides you in real time while you cook, giving tips and adjustments so every dish turns out just the way you like it.

Your mission as CMO
Build and run the brand, content, and growth strategy from scratch.
Create viral content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.
Design, launch, and optimize paid ad campaigns (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads) based on data.
Bring content creators and chefs onto the platform and manage influencer partnerships.
Build and lead a team of creators, video editors, and community managers.
Define the growth playbook: launches, referrals, SEO, email marketing, and community.
Track results (CAC, conversion, retention) and adjust the strategy.

What we're looking for
BSc and/or Master's in Media, Communications, Marketing, Advertising, or a related field.

• We also accept applications from students that want to level up in their career.
Strong skills in CapCut and AI tools for content creation (text, image, video, and voice: ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, ElevenLabs, or similar).
A proven track record of growing brands or social media accounts (please share your portfolio).
Hands-on experience with ad management and digital analytics.
Creativity, brand vision, and leadership skills.
Nice to have: a passion for cooking and food.

What we offer
Equity stake.
Full creative freedom to build the brand from zero.
A true co-founder role with a real voice in company decisions.
Location: Remote.

Send your portfolio and social handles to us.
